  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Admin Manager",
  "description": "Spectrum Books Limited - We are Spectrum Books, you must have read our books. We are the conduit for ensuring millions of people have access to knowledge, which broadens horizons and increases opportunities for building a better life. We have painstakingly published quality books for over four decades having recognized the correlations between reading, knowledge acquisition, personal empowerment, and economic and societal development. We are Spectrum Books Limited! SBL is driven by excellence, and is passionate about transforming lives.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Admin Manager

Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a highly organized, technology-driven, and results-oriented Admin Manager to oversee and optimize the Company&#39;s administrative operations.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring efficient office administration, facilities management, procurement coordination, fleet and asset management, vendor management, and the implementation of administrative policies and procedures that support business objectives.
	The ideal candidate must possess strong leadership abilities, be proficient in the use of ERP and CRM systems, and have a proven track record of driving operational efficiency through technology and process improvement.
	The role requires a proactive individual with excellent organizational, analytical, and people management skills who can effectively coordinate administrative activities across the Company while maintaining high standards of professionalism, compliance, and service delivery.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee the day-to-day administrative operations of the Company to ensure efficiency and effectiveness.
	Develop, implement, and continuously improve administrative policies, procedures, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
	Manage office facilities, equipment, utilities, and workplace maintenance to ensure a safe and productive work environment.
	Supervise administrative staff, monitor performance, and provide coaching and support to enhance productivity.
	Manage the Company&#39;s assets, office inventory, and fixed asset records.
	Coordinate procurement activities, vendor selection, contract administration, and supplier relationships.
	Ensure the effective use and administration of the Company&#39;s ERP and CRM systems for administrative processes.
	Prepare administrative reports, budgets, and operational analyses for Management.
	Coordinate travel arrangements, meetings, corporate events, and logistics where required.
	Ensure compliance with Company policies, statutory requirements, and regulatory standards relating to administration.
	Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and cost optimization across administrative functions.
	Collaborate with HR, Finance, Audit, and other departments to support organizational objectives.
	Monitor office security, fleet operations, and facility management to ensure business continuity.
	Perform any other administrative duties as may be assigned by Management.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree (minimum of Second Class Lower) in Business Administration, Public Administration, Management, or any related discipline.
	Minimum of 4 years&#39; proven experience as an Administrative Manager or in a similar leadership role.
	Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with ERP systems for administrative operations
	Good working knowledge of CRM software and digital workflow management tools.
	Excellent computer proficiency, particularly in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) and Google Workspace.
	Highly technology-driven with the ability to leverage digital tools to improve administrative efficiency.
	Demonstrated experience in managing office operations, facilities, logistics, and administrative budgets.
	Strong leadership skills with the ability to supervise, coach, and manage administrative staff effectively.
	Excellent organizational and planning skills with exceptional attention to detail.
	Ability to develop, implement, and enforce administrative policies, procedures, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
	Strong vendor, procurement, and contract management experience.
	Experience coordinating office maintenance, security, utilities, fleet management, and facility management.
	Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced work environment.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make sound decisions.
	Excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
	High level of integrity, professionalism, confidentiality, and accountability.
	Strong report writing and documentation skills.
	Ability to analyse administrative processes and recommend improvements.
	Experience working with performance metrics, service level agreements (SLAs), and key performance indicators (KPIs).
	Ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and support organizational projects.
	Proven ability to manage change and drive process improvement initiatives.
	Must be proactive, resourceful, and able to work with minimal supervision.
	Must possess excellent time management and multitasking skills.
	Experience in a manufacturing, publishing, FMCG, logistics, or similar structured organization will be an added advantage.
	Must reside in Ibadan or be willing to relocate immediately.
	Must be available to resume immediately.


Salary
N230,000 - N250,000 / Month",

Admin Manager Job at Spectrum Books Limited




        
    

        
        Spectrum Books Limited - We are Spectrum Books, you must have read our books. We are the conduit for ensuring millions of people have access to knowledge, which broadens horizons and increases opportunities for building a better life. We have painstakingly published quality books for over four decades having recognized the correlations between reading, knowledge acquisition, personal empowerment, and economic and societal development. We are Spectrum Books Limited! SBL is driven by excellence, and is passionate about transforming lives.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Admin Manager

Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a highly organized, technology-driven, and results-oriented Admin Manager to oversee and optimize the Company's administrative operations.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring efficient office administration, facilities management, procurement coordination, fleet and asset management, vendor management, and the implementation of administrative policies and procedures that support business objectives.
	The ideal candidate must possess strong leadership abilities, be proficient in the use of ERP and CRM systems, and have a proven track record of driving operational efficiency through technology and process improvement.
	The role requires a proactive individual with excellent organizational, analytical, and people management skills who can effectively coordinate administrative activities across the Company while maintaining high standards of professionalism, compliance, and service delivery.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee the day-to-day administrative operations of the Company to ensure efficiency and effectiveness.
	Develop, implement, and continuously improve administrative policies, procedures, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
	Manage office facilities, equipment, utilities, and workplace maintenance to ensure a safe and productive work environment.
	Supervise administrative staff, monitor performance, and provide coaching and support to enhance productivity.
	Manage the Company's assets, office inventory, and fixed asset records.
	Coordinate procurement activities, vendor selection, contract administration, and supplier relationships.
	Ensure the effective use and administration of the Company's ERP and CRM systems for administrative processes.
	Prepare administrative reports, budgets, and operational analyses for Management.
	Coordinate travel arrangements, meetings, corporate events, and logistics where required.
	Ensure compliance with Company policies, statutory requirements, and regulatory standards relating to administration.
	Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and cost optimization across administrative functions.
	Collaborate with HR, Finance, Audit, and other departments to support organizational objectives.
	Monitor office security, fleet operations, and facility management to ensure business continuity.
	Perform any other administrative duties as may be assigned by Management.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree (minimum of Second Class Lower) in Business Administration, Public Administration, Management, or any related discipline.
	Minimum of 4 years' proven experience as an Administrative Manager or in a similar leadership role.
	Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with ERP systems for administrative operations
	Good working knowledge of CRM software and digital workflow management tools.
	Excellent computer proficiency, particularly in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) and Google Workspace.
	Highly technology-driven with the ability to leverage digital tools to improve administrative efficiency.
	Demonstrated experience in managing office operations, facilities, logistics, and administrative budgets.
	Strong leadership skills with the ability to supervise, coach, and manage administrative staff effectively.
	Excellent organizational and planning skills with exceptional attention to detail.
	Ability to develop, implement, and enforce administrative policies, procedures, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
	Strong vendor, procurement, and contract management experience.
	Experience coordinating office maintenance, security, utilities, fleet management, and facility management.
	Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced work environment.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make sound decisions.
	Excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
	High level of integrity, professionalism, confidentiality, and accountability.
	Strong report writing and documentation skills.
	Ability to analyse administrative processes and recommend improvements.
	Experience working with performance metrics, service level agreements (SLAs), and key performance indicators (KPIs).
	Ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and support organizational projects.
	Proven ability to manage change and drive process improvement initiatives.
	Must be proactive, resourceful, and able to work with minimal supervision.
	Must possess excellent time management and multitasking skills.
	Experience in a manufacturing, publishing, FMCG, logistics, or similar structured organization will be an added advantage.
	Must reside in Ibadan or be willing to relocate immediately.
	Must be available to resume immediately.


Salary
N230,000 - N250,000 / Month

Admin Officer Job at Razley Prints Limited




        
    

        
        Razley Prints Limited is a top leading Branding and Packaging company with its headquarter in Abuja.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Admin Officer
Job Location: Abuja
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Manage daily office operations and administrative tasks.
	Handle incoming calls, emails, and customer inquiries professionally.
	Maintain accurate records of customer orders, invoices, receipts, and company documents.
	Prepare quotations, purchase orders, reports, and correspondence.
	Coordinate with the production team to monitor job schedules and delivery timelines.
	Manage office supplies and ensure timely procurement of materials.
	Maintain filing systems, both physical and electronic.
	Schedule meetings, appointments, and staff activities.
	Assist with payroll documentation, staff attendance, and leave records.
	Monitor inventory of office stationery and printing consumables.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Human Resources Generalist

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Head, Human Resources

&nbsp;

Position Summary


	We are seeking an exceptional Human Resources Officer who is passionate about building great workplaces and delivering excellent HR services.
	If you enjoy solving people challenges, creating structure, and executing HR initiatives from start to finish, we&#39;d love to hear from you.
	The HR Officer will support and coordinate the full employee lifecycle&mdash;from workforce planning and recruitment through onboarding, performance management, employee engagement, learning and development, HR operations, compliance, and employee exit.
	This is an execution-focused role requiring someone who is proactive, resourceful, detail-oriented, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
	We are looking for someone who has actively participated in and delivered HR activities.


Key Responsibilities
&nbsp;Recruitment &amp; Talent Acquisition:


	Manage end-to-end recruitment processes.
	Prepare and publish job advertisements.
	Source candidates using multiple recruitment channels.
	Screen CVs and prepare interview shortlists.
	Coordinate interview logistics.
	Conduct first-level interviews where required.
	Prepare interview reports and recommendations.
	Conduct reference and background checks.
	Prepare employment offers and onboarding documentation.
	Maintain recruitment metrics and reports.
	Build and maintain a quality talent pipeline.


Onboarding &amp; Employee Experience:


	Coordinate onboarding for all new hires.
	Prepare employee files and documentation.
	Conduct HR orientation sessions.
	Ensure completion of onboarding requirements.
	Monitor probation and confirmation processes.
	Coordinate employee engagement activities.
	Promote Sage Grey Finance&#39;s culture and values.


HR Operations &amp; Administration:


	Maintain accurate employee records.
	Prepare HR correspondence including confirmation, promotion, disciplinary, transfer, and exit letters.
	Update HR databases and trackers.
	Generate periodic HR reports.
	Ensure proper documentation and filing.
	Coordinate employee documentation and compliance.


Performance Management:


	Coordinate the performance management cycle.
	Track KPIs and appraisal timelines.
	Support managers during appraisal exercises.
	Prepare performance reports.
	Maintain performance records.


Learning &amp; Development:


	Coordinate training programmes.
	Maintain training calendars.
	Track employee learning records.
	Conduct post-training evaluations.
	Support competency development initiatives.


Employee Relations:


	Respond professionally to employee enquiries.
	Support grievance and disciplinary processes.
	Document HR meetings.
	Promote positive employee relations.
	Maintain confidentiality in all HR matters.


Compliance:


	Ensure compliance with labour regulations and company policies.
	Support HR audits.
	Maintain statutory HR documentation.
	Assist with policy implementation and review.


Exit Management:


	Coordinate resignation and exit processes.
	Conduct exit interviews.
	Prepare exit documentation.
	Coordinate clearance procedures.
	Update HR records.


HR Projects:


	Support organizational development initiatives.
	Participate in HR transformation projects.
	Support policy development and review.
	Assist with culture-building initiatives.
	Perform other HR-related responsibilities as assigned.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Industrial Relations, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 2 years&#39; practical HR experience.
	Membership or certification with CIPM is an added advantage.
	Applicants must demonstrate practical, hands-on experience in most of the following areas:
	
		End-to-end recruitment.
		Employee onboarding.
		Performance management.
		Learning &amp; Development coordination.
		Employee engagement.
		HR documentation.
		Employee relations.
		HR reporting and analytics.
		HR compliance.
		Exit management.
	
	
	Experience should be from active participation and execution&mdash;not observation alone. If your experience is largely theoretical or limited to observing others perform these responsibilities, this role may not be the right fit.


Technical Competencies:
The successful candidate should demonstrate proficiency in:


	Microsoft Excel (Intermediate to Advanced).
	Microsoft Word.
	Microsoft PowerPoint.
	HRIS/HR software.
	HR reporting.
	HR documentation.
	Recruitment tools.
	Applicant tracking systems (ATS) (where applicable).


Behavioural Competencies:
The ideal candidate should:


	Be highly organized.
	Have exceptional attention to detail.
	Take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
	Work independently with minimal supervision.
	Manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
	Thrive in a fast-paced environment.
	Demonstrate professionalism at all times.
	Maintain confidentiality.
	Possess excellent interpersonal skills.
	Have strong written and verbal communication skills.
	Show initiative and a solution-oriented mindset.
	Be adaptable and eager to learn.
	Embody integrity, accountability, and a strong work ethic.


Why Join Sage Grey Finance?


	At Sage Grey Finance, you won&#39;t be limited to one aspect of HR.
	You&#39;ll gain exposure across the full HR value chain, contribute to strategic initiatives, help shape organizational culture, and grow into a well-rounded HR professional while making meaningful impact.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: careers@sage-grey.com using &quot;Human Resource Officer&quot; as the subject of the email.",
